themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist parties across Europe are launching major election campaigns and coalition maneuvering ahead of upcoming national ballots. From Spain to Poland and Norway, conservative leaders are framing election contests as pivotal battles for national identity, institutional control, and political restoration.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Officially kicked off its nationwide campaign for the November 29 general election with massive rallies demanding the removal of Sanchez's government.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Consolidated its presidential momentum with Marine Le Pen topping long-term 2027 polls as party leaders prepare grassroots strategy.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Jarosław Kaczyński proposed a single unified right-wing election list to rally conservative forces against the ruling coalition.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Surged in regional and national polling, positioning Sylvi Listhaug as a potential prime ministerial candidate amid right-wing coalition talks.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements are escalating demands for strict immigration limits, prioritizing native citizens in social policy, and adopting radical terms like 'remigration'. Parties across Spain, Germany, France, and the UK are mirroring rhetoric and policy proposals targeting foreign workers, asylum seekers, and illegal integration.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Centered its 29N campaign on 'prioridad nacional', advocating for capping migrant children in classrooms, taxing remittances, and restricting non-emergency healthcare.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Pushed controversial 'remigration' proposals and hardline migration motions in state and federal legislative debates.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Defended national priority language, asserting France must stop importing immigrants who oppose French culture and values.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Staged a boycott of the Welsh Senedd after an elected member was disciplined for speaking about white demographic replacement.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Conservative leaders and right-wing political movements across Latin America and Europe face escalating legal scrutiny, judicial rulings, and police inquiries. Right-wing figures consistently frame these state-level legal challenges as politically orchestrated efforts by ruling establishments to neutralize opposition leaders.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: The Prosecutor General recommended the Supreme Court reject Jair Bolsonaro's final attempt to overturn his 27-year coup conviction.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Prosecutors summoned presidential candidate Karol Nawrocki for questioning, while PiS denounced law enforcement demands targeting conservative media networks.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella launched legal proceedings over allegations of past antisemitic writings while fighting media investigative probes.

themes.title: Anti-Establishment Hostility to Public Media and Information Control
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties are increasing their broadsides against state-funded news organizations, media regulators, and EU-wide digital speech frameworks. Leaders accuse mainstream public broadcasting networks of ideological bias, censorship, and unfairly undermining populist candidates.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Filed formal complaints with the Electoral Board against public television anchors and boycotted interviews with mainstream digital platforms.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Condemned state prosecutor demands for footage from right-wing stations wPolsce24 and TV Republika as authoritarian suppression of press freedom.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Partnered in state-level legislative initiatives challenging public broadcaster funding and accused major outlets of weaponized bias.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Conservative and populist factions are actively conducting independent, cross-border diplomatic engagements to project international leadership and align strategic interests. These initiatives deliberately circumvent traditional government foreign policy channels to establish direct political and economic ties.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Dispatched MEP delegations to Caracas to meet Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado and reinforce bilateral right-wing ties.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia
countries.note: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni utilized European summits in Dublin and bilateral talks with UK figures to project Italian conservative leadership on defense.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei engaged in global outreach to align Argentina's technology and trade policies with international free-market conservative networks.
